pair.title: Add AION Home
pair.description:
{qr_markdown}

1. In the AION Home app open Profile > Assistants > Home Assistant.
2. Tap Scan QR and scan the code shown above.
3. Wait for the success message in the app, then come back here and click Submit.

error.cannot_connect: The AION gateway could not complete the pairing exchange.
error.invalid_auth: The embedded gateway API key was rejected or the link was revoked.
error.pairing_not_found: Pairing not found. Please scan the QR code in the AION app from Profile > Assistants > Home Assistant before clicking Submit.
error.pairing_consumed: This QR code has already been used. A new QR code has been generated — please scan it again from Profile > Assistants > Home Assistant and click Submit.

abort.already_configured: This AION Home link is already configured.

resync_gateway.description: Force the integration to refresh the normalized bootstrap payload from the AION gateway.
